narr: Scattered to numerous thunderstorms developed across southwest Alabama ahead of a strong spring time storm system. The storms produced an isolated severe hail event along with flash flooding in the metro Mobile area.
ev: Several reports of flash flooding across south Mobile County. Arygle Road at Half Mile Road was completely flooded. Vehicles were stranded by flood waters at AL Highway 188 and Four Mile Road. Potter Tract Road in Grand Bay and Old Pascagoula Road west of McDonald Road were also flooded.
Numerous reports of flooded roads near Mobile Infirmary, especially along Lambert Avenue. Flooding also reported on South Ann Street.
